snippet.title: BEFORE I GO | Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody an innocent inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. Withstand unforgiving parasitic abominations. Overcome intense and meticulously crafted platforming action sequences. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey? 

Check out the Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715870/Before_I_Go/
